description: This file defines the SensorSnifferCentral class responsible for managing listeners that receive analog chart data updates from the engine state, using LinkManager for registration of callbacks.

classes.name: SensorSnifferCentral
classes.description: Central class managing analog chart listeners and registering callbacks to engine state updates.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds an AnalogChartListener to the internal list of listeners to be notified on updates.
